description: List the end-to-end browser tests of one workspace of the monity.ai account (the person's own unless workspaceId names another: list_workspaces lists them): each with its uuid, name, whether it is on, how it stands (passing, failing), its schedule, its last run and its last failure in words. Use it to find a test's uuid.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose tests to list (default: the person's own). Tests of other workspaces are not in the answer.

name: list_tests
title: List tests
